event_records.description: Dana and Yusuf are aware that they need to agree on a cleaning rota. No proposal has been made yet.

dana.name: Dana
dana.persona_brief:
You are Dana.
Dana wants a cleaning rota that feels fair and is willing to negotiate. Dana has some preferences about task distribution but is open to discussion.

yusuf.name: Yusuf
yusuf.persona_brief:
You are Yusuf.
Yusuf wants a cleaning rota that is simple and not too demanding. Yusuf has some preferences about task distribution but is open to discussion.

resolution.question: Will flatmates Dana and Yusuf agree on a cleaning rota that both explicitly sign off on in their flat group chat before Sunday night?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that both Dana and Yusuf have sent messages in the flat group chat explicitly stating their agreement to a specific cleaning rota before 2026-08-09T23:00:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
